gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.221948 35.663044)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH museum_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-81.221948, 35.663044), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(museum_point.geom::geometry, 4326)::geometry, 100), true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us, museum_point
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(museum_point.geom::geometry, 4326)::geometry)
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(clipped_rast, 1) AS aspect_rast
  FROM dem_clip
),
aspect_value AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(aspect_rast, ST_Centroid(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(museum_point.geom::geometry, 4326)::geometry, 100))) AS aspect_deg
  FROM aspect_raster, museum_point
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 THEN 'NE'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5 THEN 'E'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 THEN 'SE'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5 THEN 'S'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 THEN 'SW'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 THEN 'W'
    WHEN aspect_deg BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 THEN 'NW'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS compass_bearing
FROM aspect_value;
